Find information here on different ways of financing your studies.

#### **I want financial aid**

Together we can pave the way for your professional future. At EAFIT, we have different financial aid options, both institutional and from external organizations, to give you the possibility to choose whichever option suits your needs the best.

We are proud to call you an EAFIT student. We want to see you grow and support you in your educational process. That is why we have created different scholarship options so that you can continue being part of our community.

Open for high school students with the best Prueba Saber 11(ICFES) scores.

This scholarship is aimed at medal-winning athletes from the Municipality of Medellin.

Scholarship Fund which offers full tuition exemption to high school graduates from public institutions in Medellin.
